dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The staff here look rather young.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: Ah, yeah. Most of these children were left to fend for themselves on the streets. I couldn't stand it. That's why I brought them here, so they could at least have some shelter from the elements, and warm food in their bellies.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: Of course, that food doesn't come for free. Thank goodness the kids are all happy to work for their share, and that's how this place came to be.
